2U, 25 (2.5-inch) DAE (DAE5S)
3U, 15 (2.5- or 3.5-inch) DAE (DAE6S)
Note: The 2.5-inch disks are encased in 3.5-inch cartridge-style enclosures.

Drive carrier
Disk drive
Midplane

Power supply/cooling modules
EMI shielding

text.text: In a 2U or 3U DAE, the power supply/cooling module integrates independent power supply and blower cooling assemblies into a single module. Each power supply is an auto-ranging power-factor-corrected, multi-output, off-line converter with its own line cord. In a 2U or 3U DAE, each power/cooling module has three status LEDs. On the rear of the VNX5400, the 3U DPE has two SPs (SP A and B). Each SP consists of: One battery backup unit (BBU) providing back-up power for the SP and the disk drives allowing for the flushing (data cacheing) of the vault drives whenever an AC or DC input power loss to the storage system occurs One base module featuring two integrated 4x lane 6-Gb/s SAS (encryption capable) back-end ports (labeled 1 and 0, respectively) One management module One power supply/cooling fan module (hot-swappable)
